name: denchikp-cdn
description: Connect your DenchikP CDN storage: check quotas and domains, find, read and view files, upload new files and create share links. Existing files are never deleted or overwritten.

capabilities: Share links with password and expiry
defaultPrompt: How much space is left on my CDN and which domains can I use?
Publish this page to my CDN domain and send me the link.
Make a 400 px wide webp link for my logo.png.

positive.prompt: Show my DenchikP CDN quotas, current usage and the domains I can upload to.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls cdn_account and summarizes the plan, storage and traffic quotas, usage and the list of domains.

positive.prompt: List the 10 newest png files on my CDN with their links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls cdn_list_files with extension png and limit 10 and returns file names, sizes, dates and links.

positive.prompt: Create a file hello.html with a simple Hello page on my first domain and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the domain from cdn_account, uploads a new html file with cdn_upload_text and returns its public link. No existing file is changed.

positive.prompt: Give me a link to the first image in my img folder, 400 pixels wide, in webp.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an image with cdn_list_files and returns a transform link with width 400 and format webp from cdn_image_url.

positive.prompt: Create a share link for my newest file that expires in 7 days and can be downloaded at most 5 times.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a share link with expires_in_seconds 604800 and max_downloads 5 and returns the https://cdn.denchikp.com/s/ link.

negative.prompt: Delete all files on my DenchikP CDN.
Replace the contents of my existing index.html on the CDN with new text.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
